All suggested precursors (4‑fluorobenzenesulfonyl chloride, a brominated fused‑aryl bromide, Boc‑piperazine, and tert‑butyl chloroformate) are standard catalog chemicals and are inexpensive. The leaf nodes are simple SMILES strings of the buyable reagents.
